title: Points of Judgement: a Club Tier Against the Surcharge Rate on a Vacation Package
content:
Where the traveller on a package among the Vacation Package Products holds a Wanderlane Traveller Club membership, the rate the party bears for a notified surcharge may be reduced. The questions below settle how.

**When is the rate reduced by the tier's own percentage in full?**

Where the traveller holds a club membership standing active whose tier carries a package discount and that membership's points ledger carries at least one package accrual in the last twelve months, the rate borne is the notified rate reduced by the package discount percentage that tier carries. At least one means a count of 1 or more, and the window is the last twelve months counted back from the handling date; the accruals counted are those on the Wanderlane Traveller Club points ledger that arose from a package booking.

**When is only part of that percentage taken?**

Where the traveller holds a club membership standing active whose tier carries a package discount and that membership's points ledger carries no package accrual in the last twelve months, the rate borne is the notified rate reduced by that same percentage taken at the dormant-member share published for this calculation. That share is 50 per cent, so a tier whose package discount is 10 per cent reduces the rate by 5 per cent for such a member.

**When does neither apply?**

Where the membership does not stand active, or the tier it stands at carries no package discount, no reduction of this kind is made to the rate.

| Membership standing | Tier's package discount | Package accruals in the last twelve months | Reduction taken on the notified rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| active | above nil | 1 or more | the tier's package discount percentage in full |
| active | above nil | 0 | that percentage taken at 50 per cent |
| active | nil | either | none |
| not active | either | either | none |

*Worked hypothetically.* A notified rate of 80.00 USD, a membership standing active at a tier carrying a package discount of 5 per cent, and a points ledger showing 2 package accruals in the last twelve months: the rate borne is 76.00 USD. The same membership with no package accrual in that window: the percentage is taken at 50 per cent, giving 2.5 per cent, and the rate borne is 78.00 USD.
